titulo: Added antibody step improves the reliability of Alzheimer's blood tests
resumo: Researchers at University Medicine Halle have developed a new method that could improve the reliability of blood tests for Alzheimer's disease. In a study involving 315 participants, the research team demonstrated improved accuracy in distinguishing Alzheimer's disease from other conditions. After creating PEP 836 ("JIT Go Brrr: The Path to a Supported JIT Compiler for CPython") to try to meet the council's request, and after months of discussion, the JIT maintainers have withdrawn the PEP. titulo: Microsoft pulls 7 eMudhra certificates from Windows. Here’s what that means
resumo: Yesterday, October 26th, Microsoft released a Windows security update that removes seven certificates associated with Indian company eMudhra. The reason for this is that the private keys for eight intermediate certificates held by eMudhra were recently discovered to be so weak that they could be easily recreated, allowing attackers to forge digital certificates and pose as legitimate websites or applications. Microsoft had previously blocked the affected certificates directly on October 20th, but this new measure goes further by also removing seven certificates higher up in the certificate hierarchy. A similar change is scheduled for Microsoft Edge today, October 27th. For ordinary Windows users, the recommendation is to allow automatic certificate updates and browser updates to run as normal. However, computers without an internet connection or with automatic certificate updates disabled may need to be updated manually. For more details and the next steps, this Microsoft blog post .

titulo: Google Fotos ganha visual redesenhado e agora deixa usuário personalizar aba "Álbuns"

No Android, a página tinha uma lista de atalhos na parte inferior , com as opções “Capturas de tela”, “Vídeos”, “Adicionados recentemente”, “Arquivo” e “Pasta trancada”. Com o novo visual, a seção “Fixados” aparece no topo com um carrossel que inclui “Favoritos”, “Prints” e “Lixeira” por padrão. For Fedora 44 release you need to have a temporary workaround when booting. If you update to the latest kernel/firmware straight away this isn't then needed beyond the first boot. The workaround isn't needed for Fedora 45 so if you're going to try this out I suggest you go and grab your favourite flavour of Fedora from the Fedora 45 release candidates and jump straight in there! You will get an accelerated desktop with storage/network/USB. There's not currently any support for sound and a number of other things. See Robinson's post for instructions on creating an Fedora image to use with a Raspberry Pi 5.
